versions.changelog:
- Initial release of apex-evolution-insight signal.
- Provides weekly strategy evolution insights from APEX’s live autonomous trading system.
- Requires only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet for access; no API key, account, or subscription needed.
- Offers tiered pricing with early adopter discounts and automatic tier tracking.
- API endpoint: https://apexrunner.ai/signals/apex-evolution-insight, authenticated with x402.
